concerns.text: The plan substitutes the required Planck 2018 SMICA CMB map (FR‑001) with a publicly‑verified HEALPix CMB dataset from HuggingFace (COBE‑FIRAS). This dataset is not the Planck SMICA map mandated by the specification, making the analysis unsuitable for testing the supervoid hypothesis as defined.

For the galaxy density field the plan re‑uses the same HEALPix CMB parquet as a placeholder, rather than the SDSS‑DR16 or DES galaxy catalogs required by FR‑001. Using a temperature map as a proxy for galaxy density violates the data‑modality requirement and undermines scientific validity.

Generating ≥ 10 000 ΛCDM Gaussian realizations with CLASS on the GitHub Actions free‑tier runner (2 CPU cores, ≤ 7 GB RAM, ≤ 6 h) is unlikely to complete within the allotted runtime and memory budget. CLASS simulations are CPU‑intensive; the stated compute budget makes this requirement infeasible under the platform constraints.
